items.title: Byron Stripling interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 25, 1998 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: Look at Aretha Franklin was raised in the church through the way she sang, you know — was able to really get her talent going there.

ctx.x: They’re very forgiving in church, it’s true. And it’s helped a lot of people. Look at Aretha Franklin was raised in the church through the way she sang, you know — was able to really get her talent going there. And so many artists have been like that.
You mentioned an anecdote about getting to see Count Basie and so forth. Did you have aspirations to play in the big bands that were still around as a young man?
